RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 15

An all-female panel choosing a qualified candidate is not evidence of bias. For a "head of" position at a bank, regulatory expertise, governance, and leadership skills are routinely prioritized over technical credentials like a PhD. 

Raising sex discrimination without concrete evidence will likely damage your professional reputation and burn bridges across a specialized industry. 

Instead, send a polite follow-up requesting constructive feedback on areas to strengthen, such as regulatory affairs or executive stakeholder management. Delays of two weeks for written feedback are common in corporate HR. Treat the panel's demographics as incidental unless tangible evidence of discrimination emerges.
